summary.zh: 电力系统设计课程的知识教学：理解概念、预测变化、调整模型、修改代码，再独立核对结果。
summary.en: Power Systems Design lessons: understand concepts, predict changes, adjust models, edit code, then verify independently.

title.zh: 课程导论与电力系统概览

summary.zh: 从设备、单线图和功率账本出发，建立“表示—计算—核查”的设计流程。
summary.en: Build the represent–calculate–check workflow from equipment, one-line diagrams, and power accounting.

goals.zh: 说出发电、变压、输电、母线、负荷和并联补偿的作用。
goals.en: Explain generators, transformers, lines, buses, loads, and shunt compensation.

goals.zh: 区分 MW、Mvar、MVA，并用统一符号核对功率账本。
goals.en: Distinguish MW, Mvar, and MVA and reconcile power with a declared sign convention.

goals.zh: 先声明数据、参考方向和模型假设，再判断计算结果。
goals.en: Declare data, reference directions, and assumptions before interpreting a result.

opening.zh: 负荷需要 80 MW、30 Mvar。若线路和变压器有损耗，发电机能只提供 80 MW 吗？先预测并联电容改变哪一项。
opening.en: A load requires 80 MW and 30 Mvar. Can the generator supply only 80 MW when equipment has losses? Predict which quantity shunt capacitors change.

body.zh: 发电机提供电能；变压器连接电压等级；线路连接母线；负荷消耗功率；并联元件注入或吸收无功。单线图用一条路径表示三相网络，同时保留设备端点和角色。
body.en: Generators supply energy, transformers connect voltage levels, lines connect buses, loads consume power, and shunts inject or absorb reactive power. A one-line preserves equipment endpoints and roles while representing a three-phase network.

body.zh: P 描述平均能量转换，Q 描述无功交换，|S| 描述设备的电压电流容量。设备额定 MVA 与有功 MW 不能直接互换。
body.en: P describes average energy conversion, Q reactive exchange, and |S| voltage–current loading. Equipment MVA ratings and real MW are not interchangeable.

body.zh: 本案例负荷 P、Q 为消耗正值，电容 Qc 为注入正值。线路和变压器的有功损耗、无功吸收加入电源需求。先核对局部母线，再核对全系统。
body.en: Here load P and Q are positive consumption and capacitor Qc is positive injection. Add equipment real loss and reactive absorption to the source requirement. Check the receiving bus before the complete system.

body.zh: 先用手算判断数量级，再用可编辑 Python 复现，最后检查单位、符号、守恒和限值。课程工具包括讲义、教材、Python 与 PowerWorld；这里的网页实验服务于稳态模型理解。
body.en: Estimate orders of magnitude by hand, reproduce them in editable Python, then check units, signs, balances, and limits. Slides, the textbook, Python, and PowerWorld support the course; these web experiments explain steady-state models.

hint.zh: 将 80 MW 负荷、3 MW 线路损耗和 1 MW 变压器损耗相加。
hint.en: Add the 80 MW load, 3 MW line loss, and 1 MW transformer loss.

hint.zh: 电容注入从负荷无功中扣除，再加设备无功吸收。
hint.en: Subtract capacitor injection from load Q, then add equipment absorption.

hint.zh: 受端净无功 = 负荷无功 − 电容注入。
hint.en: Net receiving Q = load Q − capacitor injection.

question.zh: 电容从 10 Mvar 增加到 20 Mvar，给定损耗保持不变时会怎样？
question.en: What happens when capacitor injection increases from 10 to 20 Mvar with prescribed losses unchanged?

label.en: Both generator P and Q fall by 10

label.zh: 电源 Q 减少 10 Mvar，P 不变
label.en: Generator Q falls by 10 Mvar; P is unchanged

label.zh: 电源 Q 增加 10 Mvar

feedback.zh: 电容改变无功账本；本模型有功负荷与损耗没有改变。
feedback.en: The capacitor changes the reactive account; real load and prescribed loss are unchanged.

feedback.zh: 正确。按正注入约定，更多电容注入减少电源无功需求。
feedback.en: Correct. Positive capacitor injection reduces the source reactive requirement.

feedback.zh: 检查 QG = QL − Qc + Q设备 中 Qc 的负号。
feedback.en: Check the minus sign on Qc in QG = QL − Qc + Qequipment.

worked.en: Receiving bus: Qnet = 30 − 10 = 20 Mvar.
Line sending end: P = 83 MW and Q = 25 Mvar.
Generator: P = 84 MW and Q = 27 Mvar.

worked.zh: 用线电压 138 kV 和线路送端 |S| 计算平衡三相电流，约 362.657 A。
worked.en: Using 138 kV line voltage and sending-end |S| gives balanced current ≈ 362.657 A.

limits.zh: 这是采用给定损耗的功率账本；电流按平衡三相关系估算。改变电压会改变估算电流，损耗仍由输入给定。
limits.en: This account uses prescribed equipment losses and a balanced three-phase current estimate. Voltage changes the estimated current; loss values remain input data.

challenge.zh: 比较 69 kV 与 138 kV 的电流。解释为何实际线路的 I²R 损耗需要另一个阻抗模型来计算。
challenge.en: Compare current at 69 and 138 kV. Explain why physical I²R losses require a line-impedance model.

given.zh: 负荷 80 MW、30 Mvar；电容 10 Mvar；线路损耗 3 MW、吸收 5 Mvar；变压器损耗 1 MW、吸收 2 Mvar。
given.en: Load 80 MW/30 Mvar; capacitor 10 Mvar; line loss 3 MW/absorption 5 Mvar; transformer loss 1 MW/absorption 2 Mvar.

summary.zh: 从时序负荷、能量和备用裕度，走到成本筛选、机组数量与容量信用。
summary.en: Move from demand, energy, and reserve margin to screening costs, unit counts, and capacity credit.

goals.zh: 对同一负荷记录排序，验证能量守恒。
goals.en: Sort a load record and verify unchanged energy.

goals.zh: 计算备用容量目标和 GT/CC 成本交叉小时。
goals.en: Calculate reserve capacity targets and GT/CC crossover hours.

goals.zh: 先覆盖负荷，再按可信容量核对备用，并识别简化假设。
goals.en: Cover net load, then check accredited reserve and identify the simplifications.

opening.zh: 4380 MW 峰值、4850 MW 可信容量和 15% 备用目标是否相容？在 2000 与 6000 运行小时下，GT 和 CC 的选择是否一样？
opening.en: Do 4380 MW peak, 4850 MW accredited capacity, and 15% reserve agree? Is the GT/CC choice the same at 2000 and 6000 operating hours?

body.zh: 负荷 MW 是功率率；每个两小时块的能量为 MW×2 h，合计得到 MWh。L03 的日曲线与 L04 的年曲线是不同记录，不能将一天直接当一年。
body.en: Demand in MW is a rate. A two-hour block contributes MW×2 h to MWh. The L03 daily record and L04 annual record are distinct; do not treat one day as a year.

body.zh: 将相同持续时间的负荷从大到小排序，不改变总能量，但会丢失时序。备用目标按可信规划容量核对；它不能单独证明所有运行时刻都可靠。
body.en: Sorting equal-duration blocks retains energy but loses chronology. Compare reserve with accredited planning capacity; that check alone does not establish reliability at every operating time.

body.zh: 固定成本 F 的单位为 $/MW-year，变动成本 v 为 $/MWh，T 为 h/year。不同技术的年成本相等时得到交叉小时；平行曲线可能没有唯一交点。
body.en: F is in $/MW-year, v in $/MWh, and T in h/year. Equating annual costs gives crossover hours; parallel curves may have no unique crossover.

title.zh: 4. 从 MW 层到机组数量
title.en: 4. From MW layers to unit counts

body.zh: L04 年负荷为 4200、3400、2600、1800 MW，边界为 0、1000、4000、7000、8760 h。这里用恒定风光出力扣减形成简化净负荷。逐 MW 层比较成本，CC 按 543 MW、GT 按 211 MW 向上取整，再增加 GT 满足备用目标。
body.en: The L04 annual levels are 4200, 3400, 2600, 1800 MW at 0, 1000, 4000, 7000, 8760 h. Constant renewable output forms this simplified net load. Compare each MW layer, round CC at 543 MW and GT at 211 MW, then add GT for reserve.

hint.zh: 十二个 MW 数值相加后乘 2 h。
hint.en: Sum all twelve MW values and multiply by 2 h.

question.zh: 把负荷排序为持续曲线后，哪项信息保持不变？
question.en: Which information is preserved by sorting a load-duration curve?

label.zh: 每个负荷值发生的钟表时刻
label.en: The clock time of each load
Total energy of the same record

feedback.zh: 排序保留负荷和持续时间，但不保留发生时刻。
feedback.en: Sorting retains demand and durations, not clock times.

feedback.zh: 排序丢失时序；爬坡与启停分析需要原时序记录。
feedback.en: Sorting loses chronology; ramp and commitment analysis needs the original record.

feedback.zh: 正确。相同持续时间的块只是重新排列，总 MWh 不变。
feedback.en: Correct. Equal-duration blocks are reordered without changing MWh.

worked.zh: L03：12 个两小时块合计 77960 MWh；峰值 4380 MW。
worked.en: L03: twelve two-hour blocks total 77960 MWh; peak is 4380 MW.

worked.zh: 现有 PRM ≈ 10.731%；15% 目标需要 5037 MW，缺口 187 MW。
worked.en: Current PRM ≈ 10.731%; the 15% target is 5037 MW, leaving 187 MW.

worked.zh: GT/CC 成本交点 T* ≈ 4511.481 h/year；2000 h 时 GT 成本更低。
worked.en: GT/CC crossover is ≈ 4511.481 h/year; GT costs less at 2000 h.

worked.zh: L04 简化净负荷要求连续 CC 容量 1800 MW，取 4 台 CC 后，需 6 台 GT 覆盖峰值。
worked.en: The simplified L04 net load assigns 1800 MW to CC; rounding to four CC units leaves six GT units for peak coverage.

worked.zh: 默认风光容量信用为 0；再加 7 台 GT，可信容量 4915 MW ≥ 4830 MW 备用目标。
worked.en: Default renewable capacity credit is zero; seven additional GT units give 4915 MW ≥ the 4830 MW reserve target.

limits.zh: 默认风光块出力恒定，容量信用单独输入。机组向上取整并追加 GT 给出可行教学组合；成本曲线按固定、变动成本比较，未加入启停或爬坡约束。
limits.en: Renewable output blocks are constant and capacity credit is a separate input. Rounding and adding GT give a feasible teaching portfolio; costs use fixed/variable coefficients without startup or ramp constraints.

challenge.zh: 把 GT 与 CC 的变动成本设成相同，观察“无唯一交点”。再改变容量信用，说明出力扣减与备用信用为何是两种输入。
challenge.en: Set equal GT and CC variable costs and inspect the lack of a unique crossover. Change capacity credit and explain why energy output and reserve credit are separate inputs.

summary.zh: 连接 RMS 相量、复功率、功率三角形与并联电容补偿。
summary.en: Connect RMS phasors, complex power, the power triangle, and shunt capacitor correction.

goals.zh: 保持 RMS、余弦参考与电流方向一致。
goals.en: Keep RMS, cosine reference, and current direction consistent.

goals.zh: 用电流共轭计算 P、Q、|S| 与功率因数。
goals.en: Use the current conjugate to calculate P, Q, |S|, and power factor.

goals.zh: 计算目标无功、电容容量和补偿后电源电流。
goals.en: Calculate target Q, capacitor rating, and corrected source current.

opening.zh: 120 V RMS、10 A RMS，电压超前电流 50°。为什么 P 不是 1200 W？把 pf 提高到 0.95 后，电源电流会如何变化？
opening.en: At 120 V RMS and 10 A RMS, voltage leads current by 50°. Why is P not 1200 W? How does source current change when pf reaches 0.95?

body.zh: 波形系数是峰值 √2×RMS；相量幅值采用 RMS。完整的波形—相量转换与相量加法实验保留在原 L05 页面，本模块继续连接到功率计算。
body.en: The waveform coefficient is peak = √2×RMS, while phasor magnitude is RMS. The original L05 page retains the full conversion and phasor-addition lesson; this module connects it to power.

body.zh: 电流进入负荷正电压端，采用被动符号。Δφ = φV−φI；Δφ>0 对应滞后电流和正 Q。先算 S = V I*，再分别读取 P 与 Q。
body.en: Current enters the positive load terminal, using the passive convention. Δφ = φV−φI; positive Δφ means lagging current and positive Q. Calculate S = V I* before reading P and Q.

body.zh: P 是 |S| 在有功轴上的投影，pf = P/|S|。负 Q 表示超前电流；只写 pf 数值会遗漏超前或滞后信息。瞬时功率含振荡项，但平均值为 P。
body.en: P is the real-axis projection of |S| and pf = P/|S|. Negative Q means leading current; a pf number alone omits lead/lag. Instantaneous power oscillates while its average is P.

body.zh: 保持负荷 P 不变，目标滞后无功为 P tan(arccos pf目标)。电容提供 Qc = Q负荷−Q目标。只有需要减少感性无功时才增加电容；已经满足目标或为容性负荷时，本实验不增加电容。
body.en: Keep load P fixed. Target lagging Q is P tan(arccos target pf), and Qc = Qload−Qtarget. Add capacitance only to reduce inductive Q; this lab adds none when the target is already met or the load is capacitive.

hint.zh: 用 120×10×cos50°，幅值是 RMS。
hint.en: Use 120×10×cos50° with RMS magnitudes.

hint.zh: 用 120×10×sin50°；滞后电流对应正 Q。
hint.en: Use 120×10×sin50°; lagging current gives positive Q.

label.zh: 目标 pf=0.95 所需 C

hint.zh: 先求 Qc，再除以 377×120²，并乘 10⁶。
hint.en: Find Qc, divide by 377×120², then multiply by 10⁶.

question.zh: 在被动符号约定下，哪一种操作计算负荷复功率？
question.en: Which operation gives load complex power under the passive convention?

feedback.zh: 没有共轭会把角度相加，而不是求电压—电流相位差。
feedback.en: Without the conjugate the angles add instead of giving voltage–current difference.

feedback.zh: 正确。电流共轭给出 φV−φI。
feedback.en: Correct. Conjugating current gives φV−φI.

feedback.zh: 两者共轭不能给出所需的负荷功率符号。
feedback.en: Conjugating both does not give the required load-power sign.

worked.en: Δφ = 50° and |S| = 1200 VA.

worked.zh: 目标无功 ≈ 253.529 var；电容提供 ≈ 665.724 var。
worked.en: Target Q ≈ 253.529 var; capacitor rating ≈ 665.724 var.

worked.zh: C ≈ 122.628 μF；负荷电流仍为 10 A，电源电流降到约 6.766 A。
worked.en: C ≈ 122.628 μF; load current remains 10 A while source current falls to ≈ 6.766 A.

limits.zh: 模型为单频正弦稳态、恒定电压和固定负荷功率。电容补偿改变电源无功和电流；归一化曲线只比较相位。
limits.en: The model assumes single-frequency sinusoidal steady state, fixed voltage, and fixed load power. Correction changes source Q and current; normalized curves compare phase only.

challenge.zh: 将 Δφ 改为 −30°，解释 Q 的符号和“无新增电容”。修改 Python 中的相位，检查 P²+Q²=|S|²。
challenge.en: Set Δφ to −30° and explain Q and the absence of added capacitance. Edit the Python phase and check P²+Q²=|S|².

given.zh: V=120 V RMS，I=10 A RMS，电压超前电流 50°，ω=377 rad/s，目标 pf=0.95 滞后。
given.en: V=120 V RMS, I=10 A RMS, voltage leads current by 50°, ω=377 rad/s, target pf=0.95 lagging.

summary.zh: 在明确的相序与参考角下，从支路相量推导线量和总功率。
summary.en: Derive branch, line, and total-power quantities under declared sequence and phase references.

goals.zh: 区分相电压/线电压与支路电流/线电流。
goals.en: Distinguish phase/line voltage and branch/line current.

goals.zh: 用相量相减与节点电流关系检验 √3 和 30°。
goals.en: Check √3 and 30° using voltage differences and terminal KCL.

goals.zh: 核对三相功率和理想平衡时的零中性电流。
goals.en: Check three-phase power and zero neutral current in a balanced set.

opening.zh: 线电压 400 V，三个相同阻抗均为 20+j15 Ω。把负荷从 Y 改为 Δ，线电流是原来的 √3 倍还是 3 倍？
opening.en: At 400 V line voltage with three identical 20+j15 Ω impedances, does changing Y to Δ make line current √3 or 3 times larger?

body.zh: 本模块以虚拟电源中性点的 VAN=V相∠0° 为参考；abc 相序使 B、C 分别为 −120°、+120°。改变相序改变相角关系，而不改变平衡负荷总功率。
body.en: This module uses source VAN = Vphase∠0° relative to a reference neutral. In abc, B and C are −120° and +120°. Reversing sequence changes angles while retaining balanced-load total power.

body.zh: Y 负荷每支路承受 VLL/√3，支路电流就是线电流。对正相序，VAB=VAN−VBN 的相角比 VAN 超前 30°。
body.en: A Y branch sees VLL/√3, and branch current equals line current. For positive sequence VAB = VAN−VBN leads VAN by 30°.

body.zh: Δ 支路承受线电压，先求 IAB、IBC、ICA，再用 IA=IAB−ICA。平衡时线电流幅值为支路电流的 √3 倍。等值 Y 阻抗为 ZΔ/3。
body.en: A Δ branch sees line voltage. Find IAB, IBC, ICA, then IA = IAB−ICA. Balanced line-current magnitude is √3 times branch current. Equivalent Y impedance is ZΔ/3.

body.zh: 用三个相电压与对应线电流的共轭求和，或用支路功率求和。平衡正弦三相的瞬时总功率为常数；每相瞬时功率仍有振荡。
body.en: Sum source phase-voltage times line-current conjugates, or sum load branch powers. Balanced sinusoidal three-phase total instantaneous power is constant although each phase power oscillates.

hint.en: Compute 400/√3.

hint.zh: Y 的支路电流等于线电流，|Z|=25 Ω。
hint.en: For Y, branch current equals line current and |Z|=25 Ω.

question.zh: 保持线电压和每个支路阻抗不变，将 Y 改为 Δ，线电流变为多少？
question.en: With fixed line voltage and identical branch impedance, how much does line current increase from Y to Δ?

feedback.zh: 支路电压增加 √3，Δ 的线/支路电流关系还再乘 √3。
feedback.en: Branch voltage rises by √3, then Δ line/branch current contributes another √3.

feedback.zh: 正确。两个 √3 因子相乘得到 3；负荷阻抗没有做等值变换。
feedback.en: Correct. Two √3 factors give 3; these are unchanged impedances, not equivalent loads.

feedback.zh: 只有将 ZY 与 ZΔ 按等值关系改变，才可保持外部量不变。
feedback.en: Terminal quantities stay unchanged only when impedances are changed using the Y–Δ equivalence.

worked.en: Y branch voltage = 400/√3 ≈ 230.940 V.
Branch and line current ≈ 9.238 A; impedance angle ≈ 36.870°.

worked.zh: Δ 且同支路阻抗：I支路=16 A，I线≈27.713 A，P=15360 W。
worked.en: With the same branch impedance in Δ: branch current=16 A, line current≈27.713 A, P=15360 W.

limits.zh: 模型为理想平衡三相源、三个相同负荷阻抗和零线路阻抗。图中的电源中性点是相位参考；Δ 负荷没有中性导体。
limits.en: The model uses an ideal balanced source, three identical impedances, and zero line impedance. The source neutral provides a phase reference; a delta load has no neutral conductor.

challenge.zh: 将接线切成 Δ，再把阻抗各分量乘 3，验证线电流和总功率恢复到原 Y 的结果。切换相序后检查 VAB 相角。
challenge.en: Switch to Δ and multiply both impedance components by 3. Verify the original Y current and power return. Reverse sequence and inspect VAB phase.

given.zh: VLL=400 V RMS，正 abc 相序，Y 负荷每支路 Z=20+j15 Ω，VAN 相角为 0°。
given.en: VLL=400 V RMS, abc sequence, Y branch Z=20+j15 Ω, VAN angle 0°.

summary.zh: 从理想绕组比、试验参数和近似电路，连接到三相 Y/Δ 变压器组。
summary.en: Connect ideal winding ratios, test parameters, and approximate circuits to three-phase Y/Δ banks.

goals.zh: 区分绕组匝数比与三相线电压比。
goals.en: Distinguish winding turns ratio from three-phase line-voltage ratio.

goals.zh: 从开路、短路读数推算等值参数，并保持折算侧一致。
goals.en: Infer equivalent parameters from open/short tests with consistent referred sides.

goals.zh: 估算电压调整率、铜损与效率，并检查近似适用条件。
goals.en: Estimate regulation, copper loss, and efficiency and check approximation conditions.

opening.zh: 匝数比 a=10 时，138 kV 的高压线电压一定对应 13.8 kV 低压线电压吗？先比较 Y–Y 和 Δ–Y，再进入试验与损耗。
opening.en: Does a turns ratio a=10 always convert 138 kV high-side line voltage to 13.8 kV low-side line voltage? Compare Y–Y and Δ–Y before studying tests and losses.

body.zh: a=NH/NL=VH绕组/VL绕组；同一理想变压器内绕组电流幅值反比，复功率守恒。将低压阻抗折到高压侧时乘 a²，电压乘 a、电流除以 a。
body.en: a=NH/NL=VH,winding/VL,winding. Ideal winding-current magnitudes scale inversely and complex power is conserved. Refer low-side impedance by a², voltage by a, and current by 1/a.

body.zh: Y 的线电压为 √3×绕组电压，Δ 的线电压等于绕组电压。按每侧的接线因子算线比，不能把线比直接当成匝数比。单台额定容量为变压器组总容量的 1/3。
body.en: Y line voltage is √3 times winding voltage; Δ line voltage equals winding voltage. Apply each side’s connection factor before finding the line ratio. Each unit is rated at one-third of bank apparent power.

body.zh: Y–Δ 或 Δ–Y 接线可以产生 30° 线量相移，符号取决于端子、同名端和相序约定。这里的接线实验计算幅值；L18 的端子相量推导用于确定相移方向。
body.en: Y–Δ and Δ–Y can produce 30° line-quantity displacement; its sign depends on terminals, dot correspondence, and sequence. This connection experiment calculates magnitudes; the L18 terminal derivation determines the displacement direction.

body.zh: 开路试验主要识别励磁支路：Ic=Poc/Voc，Im=√(Ioc²−Ic²)。短路试验主要识别串联支路：|Zeq|=Vsc/Isc，Req=Psc/Isc²。读数必须满足 P≤VI，且参数必须注明试验侧。
body.en: The open test identifies excitation: Ic=Poc/Voc and Im=√(Ioc²−Ic²). The short test identifies series terms: |Zeq|=Vsc/Isc and Req=Psc/Isc². Readings require P≤VI and parameters need their test side.

body.zh: 绕组电阻产生铜损，漏抗产生串联压降，励磁支路描述磁化与铁损。这里以额定基准上的 rpu、xpu 和负载率 λ 估算滞后负荷的电压调整率。
body.en: Resistance gives copper loss, leakage reactance gives series drop, and excitation represents magnetization and core loss. Here rated-base rpu, xpu and loading λ estimate regulation at lagging pf.

body.zh: 输出有功为 S额定×λ×pf；铜损按 λ² 变化，铁损在固定电压下近似恒定。理想组的幅值、电流关系与含损耗效率分开核查。
body.en: Real output is Srated×λ×pf. Copper loss varies with λ² and core loss is approximately constant at fixed voltage. Check ideal bank ratios separately from loss-based efficiency.

opening.en: For the same 1+j4 Ω impedance, what happens when power base changes from 100 to 50 MVA? Does physical impedance change?

body.zh: 选择 Sb 与 Vb 后，其他基准必须随之导出。三相用总三相 Sb 和线电压 Vb,LL；单相用该电路的端电压和单相 Sb。
body.en: After choosing Sb and Vb, derive other bases coherently. Three-phase uses total Sb and line voltage Vb,LL; single-phase uses terminal voltage and single-phase Sb.

body.zh: 用物理量除以对应基准得到标幺量，乘回同一基准应恢复原值。电压、电流与功率基准相容时，三相 |Spu|=Vpu Ipu。
body.en: Divide physical quantities by matching bases, then multiply back to recover them. Coherent voltage, current, and power bases give |Spu|=Vpu Ipu in three-phase.

body.zh: 功率基准保持一致，电压基准按对应理想变压器比传播。这里用两侧接线因子相同的电压比 a；物理阻抗折算乘 a²，阻抗基准也乘 a²，因此标幺值不变。
body.en: Keep the same power base and propagate voltage bases through the corresponding ideal ratio. Here both connection factors match, so the voltage ratio is a. Physical impedance and its base both scale by a², retaining per-unit impedance.

body.zh: 保持物理 Z 不变，改用新的 Sb、Vb。标幺值会随基准改变；不要把改变后的 pu 数字解释为物理设备变化。
body.en: Keep physical Z fixed and choose new Sb and Vb. Per-unit numbers change with the base; do not interpret that change as modified equipment.

title.en: Winding and phase are different counts
title.zh: 绕组数与相数是不同概念

body.en: A three-phase two-winding transformer has two winding sets, with three phase coils per set. Three single-phase units can form a bank; a common-core unit provides the same terminal functions.
body.zh: 三相双绕组变压器有两组绕组，每组包含三个相线圈。三台单相变压器可组成变压器组，共铁芯结构也能实现相同的端口功能。

body.en: a compares paired dotted-to-undotted coil voltages. Y has line voltage √3 times coil voltage; Δ has equal line and coil voltages. Bank MVA is three times phase MVA.
body.zh: a 比较对应线圈从同名端到异名端的电压。Y 的线电压是线圈电压的 √3 倍；Δ 的线电压等于线圈电压。变压器组容量是每相容量的三倍。

title.en: Delta joining order and phase displacement
title.zh: 三角形连接方向与相移

body.en: Supply sequence is positive on both sides. ABC names coil directions AB, BC, CA; ACB names AC, BA, CB. Keep the paired dots fixed. Y–Δ with low abc gives δLH=−30°; switching low joining to acb gives +30°. These joining names do not reverse the supply sequence.
body.zh: 两侧均为正相序。ABC 表示线圈方向 AB、BC、CA；ACB 表示 AC、BA、CB。对应同名端保持不变。Y–Δ 的低压 abc 接法给出 δLH=−30°；切换为 acb 给出 +30°。这些连接名称并不改变电源相序。

body.en: Dyn1 indicates HV delta, LV wye, a brought-out neutral, and 30° LV lag. Dyn11 corresponds to +30° δLH. A neutral terminal being available does not specify its grounding. Y has a star point; delta has no star-point neutral, but grounding arrangements can still be provided.
body.zh: Dyn1 表示高压 Δ、低压 Y、引出中性端，低压滞后 30°。Dyn11 对应 δLH=+30°。中性端引出并不说明接地方式。Y 具有星点；Δ 没有星点中性端，但仍可采用相应接地方案。

title.zh: 三相变压器网络与分接头

summary.zh: 在 100 MVA 基准上复现 60 MVA 变压器组，探索固定基准上的复变比分接模型。

opening.en: The L18 bank is rated 60 MVA, 138/13.8 kV, Y–Δ. Its terminal ratio is 10, but its winding ratio is 10/√3. On a 100 MVA system base, does changing base change its physical impedance?
opening.zh: L18 的变压器组额定值为 60 MVA、138/13.8 kV、Y–Δ。端口比为 10，绕组比却为 10/√3。在 100 MVA 系统基准上，改变基准会改变实际阻抗吗？

goals.zh: 将绕组阻抗转换为等效 Y 相模型。

goals.en: Check per-unit base changes by recovering physical ohms.
goals.zh: 还原实际欧姆值，核查标幺基准变换。

goals.en: Distinguish a physical tap, fixed voltage bases and directional complex ratios.
goals.zh: 区分实际分接头、固定电压基准和有方向的复变比。

body.en: Use a positive-sequence model, retaining series resistance and leakage and neglecting excitation. The L-side physical delta becomes an equivalent Y impedance ZΔ/3. That equivalent neutral is a reference, not a grounding claim.
body.zh: 采用正相序模型，保留串联电阻和漏抗，忽略励磁。低压侧实际 Δ 转换为等效 Y 阻抗 ZΔ/3；等效中性点只是参考，不表示接地。

title.zh: 变压器组基准与实际阻抗

body.en: Use total three-phase Sbase and line-to-line Vbase. The L18 rated voltage bases stay fixed when Sbase changes. The two compatible side bases give the same pu impedance; a delta winding has three times the equivalent Y impedance.
body.zh: 使用三相总容量 Sbase 和线电压 Vbase。改变 Sbase 时，L18 的额定电压基准保持固定。两侧相容基准给出相同的标幺阻抗；Δ 绕组阻抗是等效 Y 阻抗的三倍。

body.en: For the L18 Y–Δ abc connection δLH=−30°, so θHL=+30°. H current enters and L current leaves. Fix the voltage bases and define tHL=τexp(jθHL); then iL=tHL* iH. Increasing active H turns increases τ and reduces ideal LV voltage at fixed HV voltage.
body.zh: L18 的 Y–Δ abc 接法给出 δLH=−30°，因此 θHL=+30°。高压电流流入、低压电流流出。固定电压基准，定义 tHL=τexp(jθHL)，则 iL=tHL 的共轭乘 iH。高压有效匝数增加会增大 τ，使固定高压电压下的理想低压电压降低。

body.en: The source slides show a series-aiding step-down autotransformer: VH=(Ns+Nc)e per turn and VL=Nc e per turn. Power is transferred through both a direct electrical path and magnetic coupling. The common connection removes galvanic isolation; a conventional two-winding bank model cannot represent that isolation difference.
body.zh: 原始课件展示串联助磁的降压自耦变压器：VH=(Ns+Nc)×每匝电压，VL=Nc×每匝电压。功率同时经直接电气通路和磁耦合传递。公共电气连接意味着没有电气隔离；普通双绕组组模型不能描述这种隔离差别。

With loading, solve vL=(vH−z iH)/tHL and iL=tHL* iH. Input minus output complex power equals z|iH|²; inspect both balance checks.

summary.en: Separate material area, temperature and return geometry, then recover one-conductor and loop impedance.
summary.zh: 区分材料面积、温度和回流几何，计算单根导线与整个回路的阻抗。

opening.en: A 75-mile line has 500 mm² of aluminum and a 14 mm outside radius. Why do resistance and inductance need different geometric information, and when should the answer be doubled?
opening.zh: 一条 75 英里线路的铝面积为 500 mm²，外半径为 14 mm。为什么电阻和电感需要不同的几何信息？什么时候才应该将结果乘 2？

goals.en: Correct resistance for temperature and supplied conductor factors.
goals.zh: 按温度和给定导线修正系数计算电阻。

goals.en: Separate internal and external flux linkage under stated assumptions.
goals.zh: 在明确假设下区分内部与外部磁通链。

goals.en: Convert per-length rates to one-conductor and two-wire loop values.
goals.zh: 将单位长度参数换算为单根导线与双线回路参数。

title.en: Metal area is not outer area
title.zh: 金属面积不等于外圆面积

body.en: Use the conducting aluminum area in ρℓ/A. Voids, strands and a steel core mean πr² need not equal the aluminum area. The radius in the magnetic example belongs to a separate ideal solid, nonmagnetic surrogate.
body.zh: ρℓ/A 使用导电铝材面积。间隙、绞线和钢芯使 πr² 不一定等于铝材面积。磁场例题中的半径用于另一个理想实心、非磁性导线近似。

body.en: The path and AC factors are supplied empirical inputs, not a skin-effect solver. The default AC factor is specified at 60 Hz; if frequency changes in edited code, a matching factor must be supplied.
body.zh: 绞线长度系数和 AC 系数是给定经验值，并非集肤效应求解。默认 AC 系数在 60 Hz 给定；修改代码改变频率时应提供相应系数。

body.en: For a nonmagnetic solid conductor with uniform current density, a shell links only the enclosed current fraction. Integrating gives 0.05 mH/km. This ideal term is not a catalog model for a stranded steel-core conductor.
body.zh: 非磁性实心导线电流密度均匀时，环形磁通只链接所包围的电流比例。积分得到 0.05 mH/km。该理想项不是钢芯绞线的目录模型。

title.zh: 外部磁通链与理想 GMR

body.en: D is the equal-return spacing with D≫r, not a boundary where the field vanishes. Combining internal and external linkage gives the ideal solid-conductor GMR r exp(−1/4). Later lectures use supplied conductor GMR directly.
body.zh: D 为等量反向回流间距，要求 D≫r，并不意味着磁场在 D 处消失。内外磁通链合并后得到理想实心导线 GMR=r exp(−1/4)。后续讲次直接使用给定目录 GMR。

body.en: Multiply rates by route length once. An equal two-wire loop includes both conductors, so its R and X are twice the one-conductor values. This factor does not carry into the balanced three-phase formula in L23.
body.zh: 单位长度参数只乘一次线路长度。等量双线回路包含两根导线，因此 R、X 均为单根值的两倍。这一系数不能用于 L23 的平衡三相每相公式。

label.zh: 理想磁场近似导线半径
60 Hz 给定 AC 修正系数
修正后 AC 电阻率

given.en: L22 worked example: 75 mi=120.7008 km; ρ20=2.8264×10⁻⁸ Ω·m; AAl=500 mm²; α20=0.00403/°C; T=75 °C; kpath=1.020; kac,60=1.030. The separate solid magnetic surrogate has r=14 mm, D=6 m, f=60 Hz.

worked.en: Convert area: 500 mm²=500×10⁻⁶ m². R′dc,20=0.056528 Ω/km; the km conversion contributes a factor of 1000.
worked.zh: 面积换算：500 mm²=500×10⁻⁶ m²。R′dc,20=0.056528 Ω/km；从 m 到 km 需要乘 1000。

worked.en: Rcond=0.0725517×120.7008=8.75705 Ω. Area scaling affects this resistance without redefining the independent magnetic radius.
worked.zh: Rcond=0.0725517×120.7008=8.75705 Ω。改变铝材面积影响电阻，不会自动重定义独立的磁场近似半径。

worked.en: L′int=0.05000 and L′ext=0.2 ln(6/0.014)=1.21209 mH/km; total L′cond=1.26209 mH/km.
Lcond=0.152335 H and Xcond=2π60Lcond=57.4291 Ω. The equal two-wire loop is 17.5141+j114.8582 Ω.
worked.zh: Lcond=0.152335 H，Xcond=2π60Lcond=57.4291 Ω。等量双线回路为 17.5141+j114.8582 Ω。

hint.en: Apply the temperature, path and AC factors to 0.056528 Ω/km.
hint.zh: 对 0.056528 Ω/km 依次应用温度、绞线长度和 AC 系数。

hint.en: Use L′=1.26209 mH/km, route length 120.7008 km and 2π60.
Two equal conductors each contribute 8.75705 Ω.
hint.zh: 两根相同导线分别贡献 8.75705 Ω。

question.en: Which area belongs in the resistance formula for a stranded conductor?
question.zh: 绞线导线的电阻公式应采用哪个面积？

label.en: The outer-circle area πr² in every case
label.zh: 任何情况下均为外圆面积 πr²

label.en: The actual conducting material area supplied for the conductor
label.zh: 给定导线的实际导电材料面积

feedback.en: Strands, voids and a core can make outer area different from metal area.
feedback.zh: 绞线、间隙和芯材使外圆面积不同于金属面积。

feedback.en: Correct. Resistance uses conducting area; the magnetic surrogate uses its separately stated radius.
feedback.zh: 正确：电阻使用导电面积；磁场近似模型使用另行给定的半径。

feedback.en: GMR summarizes magnetic self linkage, not metal area.
feedback.zh: GMR 描述磁自磁通链，并非金属面积。

challenge.en: Double AAl, then double D. Explain why resistance halves while inductance changes logarithmically. Compare one-conductor and loop answers.
challenge.zh: 将 AAl 加倍，再将 D 加倍。解释电阻减半而电感呈对数变化的原因，并比较单根导线与回路的结果。

limits.en: Resistance factors are supplied at 60 Hz. The magnetic calculation assumes nonmagnetic solid conductors, uniform current density and equal opposite currents with D≫r. Aluminum area and magnetic radius are independent inputs; this is not a detailed stranded/steel-core or skin-effect model.
limits.zh: 电阻修正系数在 60 Hz 给定。磁场计算假设非磁性实心导线、电流密度均匀、等量反向电流且 D≫r。铝材面积与磁场半径是独立输入；此模型不求解绞线、钢芯或集肤效应细节。

plot_titles.en: Internal and external inductance versus spacing

summary.en: Compute actual mutual distances and the geometric mean, then reproduce the transposed per-phase inductance.
summary.zh: 计算实际互距和几何平均距离，复现换位线路的每相电感。

opening.en: Three positions are at x=−4, 0 and +6 m. Which single spacing can represent their unequal magnetic coupling after complete transposition?
opening.zh: 三根导线位置为 x=−4、0、+6 m。完整换位后，应使用什么单一间距表示这些不等的磁耦合？

goals.en: Derive all mutual distances from physical positions.
goals.zh: 由实际位置计算全部互距。

goals.en: Explain geometric averaging through one full transposition cycle.
goals.zh: 用完整换位循环解释几何平均。

goals.en: Use catalog GMR directly and retain the per-phase interpretation.
goals.zh: 直接使用目录 GMR，保持每相量的物理意义。

body.en: P1=(−a,0), P2=(0,0), P3=(b cosθ,b sinθ). At θ=0, the arrangement is horizontal and D31=a+b. With a=b and θ=120°, it is equilateral. The angle is measured from +x, not the included P1–P2–P3 angle.
body.zh: P1=(−a,0)、P2=(0,0)、P3=(b cosθ,b sinθ)。θ=0 为水平排列，D31=a+b；a=b 且 θ=120° 时为等边三角形。θ 相对 +x 方向测量，不是 P1–P2–P3 的内角。

body.en: Magnetic terms depend on logarithms of distance. Equal-length transposition averages those logarithms. Every phase occupies every position for one third of the route; an arithmetic mean does not preserve the linkage.
body.zh: 磁场项取决于距离的对数。等长度换位对这些对数取平均，每相在每个位置占线路的三分之一；算术平均不能保持磁通链。

body.en: Use the conductor GMR Ds from its data. The 0.7788r expression applies only to the ideal solid nonmagnetic conductor of L22; do not multiply a catalog GMR by 0.7788 again.
body.zh: 采用导线资料给定的 GMR Ds。0.7788r 只适用于 L22 的理想非磁性实心导线；不要对目录 GMR 再乘一次 0.7788。

body.en: The other two phase currents sum to the negative of the selected phase current. This is already included in the balanced per-phase formula. Multiply by route length once and by ω to obtain one phase branch reactance.
body.zh: 另外两相电流之和等于所选相电流的负值，该平衡回流已包含在每相公式中。只乘一次线路长度，再乘 ω 得到一相支路电抗。

body.en: This scalar positive-sequence rate assumes complete equal-length transposition, identical conductors and balanced operation. Earth and shield wires are omitted. An untransposed line generally requires phase-domain coupling information.
body.zh: 该标量正序参数假设完整等长度换位、相同导线和平衡运行，忽略大地与地线。未换位线路通常需要相域耦合信息。

label.zh: P2→P3 相对 +x 方向的夹角

given.en: L23 example: positions (−4,25), (0,25), (+6,25) m; GMR=10.90 mm; 75 mi=120.7008 km; f=60 Hz. The common height cancels in mutual distances because this model omits earth.
given.zh: L23 例题：位置为 (−4,25)、(0,25)、(+6,25) m；GMR=10.90 mm；75 mi=120.7008 km；f=60 Hz。此模型忽略大地，因此共同高度在互距计算中抵消。

worked.en: Using the arithmetic mean 6.6667 m gives about 58.3906 Ω, 1.107% too high. Substituting a 14 mm physical radius for GMR gives about 55.4736 Ω, 3.944% too low.
worked.zh: 误用算术平均 6.6667 m 得到约 58.3906 Ω，高估 1.107%。用 14 mm 实际半径代替 GMR 得到约 55.4736 Ω，低估 3.944%。

hint.en: Take the cube root of 4×6×10.
hint.zh: 计算 4×6×10 的立方根。

hint.en: Multiply the per-km reactance by 120.7008, without an extra factor of two.
hint.zh: 将每 km 电抗乘 120.7008，不要额外乘 2。

question.en: Why is GMD geometric rather than arithmetic?
question.zh: 为什么 GMD 使用几何平均而非算术平均？

label.en: The three phase currents are always equal in phase
Equal-length transposition averages logarithmic distance terms
label.zh: 等长度换位对距离的对数项取平均

label.en: The largest spacing can always be discarded

feedback.en: Balanced phase currents are 120° apart, not equal in phase.
feedback.zh: 平衡相电流相差 120°，不是同相。

feedback.en: Correct. Averaging ln D gives the logarithm of the geometric mean.
feedback.zh: 正确：ln D 的平均等于几何平均距离的对数。

feedback.en: All three pair distances enter the transposed model.
feedback.zh: 换位模型必须包含三个互距。

challenge.en: Set both position spacings to 6 m and the +x angle to 120°. Verify that all distances and GMD are 6 m. Then double only frequency and explain which quantities change.
challenge.zh: 将两个位置间距均设为 6 m，+x 夹角设为 120°。验证三个互距及 GMD 均为 6 m。然后只将频率加倍，解释哪些量会变化。

limits.en: One conductor per phase, identical supplied GMR, complete equal-length transposition and balanced currents; earth and shield wires omitted. The position diagram depicts the geometry that is averaged, not three permanently fixed phase identities.
limits.zh: 每相一根导线，使用相同给定 GMR，完整等长度换位和平衡电流；忽略大地与地线。位置图展示被平均的几何，而非三相始终固定的位置身份。

summary.en: Use physical radius to find capacitance, split a nominal π shunt and check phase current against three-phase reactive supply.
summary.zh: 用实际半径计算电容，拆分标称 π 的并联电纳，并核对相电流与三相无功供给。

opening.en: A 138 kV line can draw current even with no receiving-end load. How does conductor geometry create this charging current, and where does it appear in a π circuit?
opening.zh: 138 kV 线路即使受端无负荷也会有电流。导线几何如何产生充电电流？它在 π 型电路中位于哪里？

goals.en: Use physical radius rather than magnetic GMR in electrostatic calculations.
goals.zh: 静电计算使用实际半径而非磁 GMR。

goals.en: Relate C, B, phase current and total three-phase reactive power.
goals.zh: 联系 C、B、相电流与三相总无功功率。

goals.en: Interpret the two shunt branches and reactive power sign.
goals.zh: 解释两个并联支路与无功功率符号。

body.en: An ideal conductor has zero electric field inside its metal. Integrating the outside field uses the physical surface radius r; the internal magnetic-linkage correction does not apply to electric potential.
body.zh: 理想导体金属内部电场为零。积分外部电场应从实际表面半径 r 开始；内部磁通链修正不适用于电势。

body.en: Balanced charges sum to zero. For equal spacing or a fully transposed arrangement, the mutual-distance terms reduce to GMD. The neutral is an electrical reference, not an added physical conductor.
body.zh: 平衡电荷之和为零。等间距或完整换位时，互距项归并为 GMD。中性点是电气参考，不表示额外实际导线。

title.en: From a rate to a route shunt
title.zh: 从单位长度参数到线路并联支路

body.en: Ctotal=C′ℓ and Btotal=ωCtotal. Unit conversions matter: nF/km multiplied by km gives nF, then divide by 1000 for μF. B is positive capacitive susceptance in Y=jB.
body.zh: Ctotal=C′ℓ，Btotal=ωCtotal。注意单位：nF/km 乘 km 得 nF，再除以 1000 得 μF。Y=jB 中 B 为正的容性电纳。

body.en: The phase charging current leads phase voltage by 90°. Under the uniform-voltage estimate, QC is positive capacitive supply; the absorbed complex reactive power is −QC. The line-voltage formula already includes all three phases.
body.zh: 相充电电流超前相电压 90°。全线等电压估算中 QC 为正的容性无功供给，吸收无功功率为 −QC。线电压公式已包含三相。

title.en: Nominal π and local terminal voltage
title.zh: 标称 π 与本端电压

body.en: Each π end has jBtotal/2. Its current uses the local phase voltage. With equal terminal magnitudes, each end supplies half QC; otherwise compute each end separately. IR=0 means no receiving load, not zero sending charging current.
body.zh: π 型每端为 jBtotal/2，支路电流使用本端相电压。两端幅值相同时各提供 QC/2，否则需分别计算。IR=0 表示受端无负荷，不代表送端充电电流为零。

label.zh: P2→P3 相对 +x 方向的夹角

label.en: Shunt susceptance at each π end

label.zh: 等电压估算的相充电电流

given.en: L24 example: distances 4, 6 and 10 m; physical radius 14 mm; air ε=ε0=8.8541878×10⁻¹² F/m; f=60 Hz; length 75 mi=120.7008 km; VLL=138 kV. GMR=10.90 mm is supplied only for a deliberate comparison.
given.zh: L24 例题：互距 4、6、10 m；实际半径 14 mm；空气 ε=ε0=8.8541878×10⁻¹² F/m；f=60 Hz；长度 75 mi=120.7008 km；VLL=138 kV。GMR=10.90 mm 仅用于故意错误的对比。

worked.en: B′=3.4406845 μS/km; Btotal=0.41529337 mS. Each π-end shunt is 0.20764669 mS.
worked.zh: B′=3.4406845 μS/km；Btotal=0.41529337 mS。π 型每端并联电纳为 0.20764669 mS。

worked.en: Using magnetic GMR as r underestimates C′ by 3.944%. At 0.95 times voltage, QC becomes 0.95² times its original value, while C and B stay unchanged.
worked.zh: 用磁 GMR 代替 r 会使 C′ 低估 3.944%。电压降为 0.95 倍时，QC 变为原来的 0.95² 倍，而 C、B 不变。

hint.en: Use physical radius 0.014 m and GMD 6.214465 m.
hint.zh: 采用实际半径 0.014 m 和 GMD 6.214465 m。

hint.en: Use total B=0.41529337 mS and phase voltage 138/√3 kV.
hint.zh: 使用总 B=0.41529337 mS 与相电压 138/√3 kV。

hint.en: Compute B VLL²; do not add another factor of three.
hint.zh: 计算 B VLL²，不要再乘 3。

question.en: Which radius enters the capacitance formula?
question.zh: 电容公式应使用哪个半径？

Outside diameter without dividing by two

feedback.en: GMR includes internal magnetic-linkage effects, which do not belong in electrostatics.
feedback.zh: GMR 包含内部磁通链效应，不适用于静电计算。

feedback.en: Correct. The potential integral starts at the physical conductor surface.
feedback.zh: 正确：电势积分从实际导线表面开始。

feedback.en: The formula requires radius; using diameter overestimates capacitance.
feedback.zh: 公式需要半径，使用直径会高估电容。

challenge.en: Reduce line voltage by 5% and predict QC before changing the slider. Then double length in Python: C, B, I and QC should double, while C′ stays fixed.
challenge.zh: 先预测线电压降低 5% 后的 QC，再移动滑块。然后在 Python 中将长度加倍：C、B、I、QC 应加倍，C′ 保持不变。

limits.en: Balanced, equal-spacing or fully transposed overhead line in a uniform dielectric; earth and shield wires omitted. Charging uses uniform line voltage and does not solve sending/receiving voltage rise. The π diagram shows parameter placement; R and X are symbolic in this capacitance-only experiment.
limits.zh: 平衡、等间距或完整换位的架空线路，均匀介质，忽略大地与地线。充电估算采用全线等电压，不求解送受端电压升高。π 图展示参数位置；本电容实验中的 R、X 为符号量。

title.en: Bundles, physical circuits and per-unit branches
title.zh: 分裂导线、物理回路与标幺支路

summary.en: Model one to four symmetric subconductors, distinguish magnetic/electric self radii and build the circuit branch on a stated system base.
summary.zh: 模拟每相一至四根对称子导线，区分磁、电自半径，并按给定系统基准建立线路支路。

opening.en: The 500 kV example has two subconductors per phase. Is that two transmission circuits? Why do resistance, reactance and charging change by different factors?
opening.zh: 500 kV 例题每相包含两根子导线。这是否表示两条输电回路？为什么电阻、电抗和充电参数的变化比例不同？

goals.en: Compute magnetic and electric bundle self distances for 1–4 members.
goals.zh: 计算 1–4 根子导线的磁、电分裂自距离。

goals.en: Recover one physical circuit’s phase R, X and total B.
goals.zh: 计算一条物理回路的每相 R、X 与总 B。

goals.en: Change the system base and distinguish a parallel-circuit equivalent.
goals.zh: 改变系统基准，并区分多回路并联等效。

title.en: One phase contains the whole bundle
title.zh: 整个分裂导线组属于一相

body.en: Symmetric identical members share phase current and charge equally. R′phase=R′sub/n. Mutual magnetic coupling means inductance cannot be divided by n as if the members were independent inductors.
body.zh: 对称且相同的子导线均分相电流和电荷，R′phase=R′sub/n。子导线存在磁互耦，不能将它们视为独立电感并把电感除以 n。

body.en: Use the same symmetric bundle geometry twice: magnetic self terms start with supplied GMR Ds, electric self terms start with physical radius r. For three members the arrangement is equilateral; for four it is a square whose side spacing is d.
body.zh: 同一对称分裂几何计算两次：磁自项从给定 GMR Ds 开始，电自项从实际半径 r 开始。三分裂为等边三角形，四分裂为边长 d 的正方形。

title.zh: 正方形对角线不可忽略

body.en: A square member has two neighbors at d and one at √2d. The √2 factor inside the fourth root belongs in both the magnetic and electric bundle radius. The phase-center GMD approximation requires a bundle much smaller than phase spacing.
body.zh: 正方形的一根子导线有两个距离 d 的邻居和一个距离 √2d 的邻居。磁、电分裂半径的四次根号内都必须包含 √2。相中心 GMD 近似要求分裂尺寸远小于相间距。

body.en: Calculate per-phase L and C using phase-center GMD and the respective bundle self radii. Multiply each rate by route length once. Three phases are represented by one balanced phase branch, not an extra factor of three in R, X or B.
body.zh: 使用相中心 GMD 和各自分裂自半径计算每相 L、C；各单位长度参数只乘一次线路长度。三相采用一条平衡相支路表示，R、X、B 不额外乘 3。

title.en: Series and shunt use reciprocal bases
title.zh: 串联与并联采用互为倒数的基准

body.en: Use line-to-line kV and total three-phase MVA for ZB in ohms. Divide series ohms by ZB; multiply shunt siemens by ZB. bpu is the total shunt, split into bpu/2 at each π end.
body.zh: 使用线电压 kV 和三相总容量 MVA 得到 Ω 单位的 ZB。串联欧姆值除以 ZB，并联西门子值乘 ZB。bpu 是总并联电纳，π 型每端为 bpu/2。

title.en: Bundle count is not circuit count

body.en: Two identical uncoupled circuits connected to the same buses give Zeq=Z/2 and Beq=2B. The individual circuit records remain unchanged. This approximation omits inter-circuit coupling and says nothing about thermal MVA limits.
body.zh: 两条相同且互不耦合的回路连接同一对母线时，Zeq=Z/2、Beq=2B，单条回路记录不变。该近似忽略回路间耦合，不能据此推断热稳定 MVA 限额。

given.en: L25 example: one 500 kV, 60 Hz circuit; length 80 mi=128.74752 km; phase spacings 32,32,64 ft; two members per phase, d=1.50 ft. Member GMR=0.0588 ft; outside diameter=1.762 in; supplied AC resistance at 25 °C=0.0105 Ω/kft. Base: 500 kV, 100 MVA.
given.zh: L25 例题：一条 500 kV、60 Hz 回路；长度 80 mi=128.74752 km；相间距 32、32、64 ft；每相两根子导线，d=1.50 ft。子导线 GMR=0.0588 ft；外径=1.762 in；25 °C 给定 AC 电阻率=0.0105 Ω/kft。基准：500 kV、100 MVA。

worked.en: R′phase=0.01722441 Ω/km; L′phase=0.98217182 mH/km; X′phase=0.37027005 Ω/km. The 80-mile circuit has R=2.2176 Ω and X≈47.67135 Ω per phase.
For two identical uncoupled circuits on the same base, divide r and x by two and multiply total b by two. Changing only Sbase changes pu values while physical circuit ohms and siemens stay fixed.
worked.zh: 同一基准上，两条相同且互不耦合回路使 r、x 除以 2，总 b 乘 2。只改变 Sbase 会改变标幺值，但单回路实际欧姆值和西门子值保持不变。

hint.en: Divide the member rate by 2, then multiply by 128.74752 km.
hint.zh: 子导线电阻率除以 2，再乘 128.74752 km。

label.zh: 原基准上的单回路电抗

hint.en: Divide the route phase reactance by 2500 Ω.
hint.zh: 线路每相电抗除以 2500 Ω。

label.en: One-circuit total shunt on the baseline
label.zh: 原基准上的单回路总并联电纳

hint.en: Convert mS to S, then multiply by 2500 Ω.
hint.zh: 将 mS 换算为 S，再乘 2500 Ω。

question.en: Two subconductors per phase and one three-phase line represent how many physical circuits?
question.zh: 每相两根子导线的一条三相线路，表示多少条物理回路？

label.en: Two circuits, so divide route impedance again by two
label.zh: 两条回路，应将线路阻抗再除以 2

label.en: One circuit; bundle effects are already in the per-phase parameters
label.zh: 一条回路，分裂影响已经包含在每相参数中

label.en: Six circuits, one for every visible wire
label.zh: 六条回路，每根可见导线各算一条

feedback.en: Bundle count changes the phase geometry, not the number of network branches.
feedback.zh: 分裂数改变相几何，不改变网络支路数。

feedback.en: Correct. A second physical circuit is a separate complete three-phase branch.
feedback.zh: 正确：第二条物理回路是另一条完整三相支路。

feedback.en: A complete three-phase circuit can contain multiple members in each phase.
feedback.zh: 一条完整三相回路的每相可以包含多根子导线。

challenge.en: Compare 1, 2, 3 and 4 members. Explain the square-diagonal factor. Then select two physical circuits and change Sbase: distinguish physical equivalencing from changing units.
challenge.zh: 比较 1、2、3、4 根子导线，解释正方形对角线系数。然后选择两条物理回路并改变 Sbase，区分实际并联等效与表示单位变化。

limits.en: Symmetric identical bundles with equal member sharing; complete transposition, balanced operation and phase-center mutual-distance approximation. Air dielectric, no earth/shield wires, corona or inter-circuit mutual coupling. Resistance is supplied AC data at 25 °C. Charging uses uniform voltage. Parameters do not determine a thermal MVA rating.
limits.zh: 对称相同分裂导线且子导线均分电流、电荷；完整换位、平衡运行、相中心互距近似。空气介质，忽略大地、地线、电晕和回路间互耦。电阻采用 25 °C 给定 AC 数据。充电采用全线等电压。参数本身不能确定热稳定 MVA 额定值。
